cases.name: Native getCache ignores stored HTML metadata
Scoped overlay can expose HTML metadata without changing Markdown
Native graph accepts Markdown-to-HTML edges with attachments enabled
HTML metadata alone does not generate HTML-to-HTML edges
Resolved HTML edges are consumed by the unmodified native graph builder
Resolved edges alone do not expose HTML tag edges
HTML metadata overlay supplies tag nodes and tag edges
Disabling attachments excludes HTML nodes and incoming HTML edges
Disabling tags leaves file edges intact and removes tag nodes

limitations: Offline execution of two extracted native functions with synthetic inputs and mocked helpers.
Not an installed plugin, live cache injection, graph UI test, or mobile compatibility test.
Lifecycle, rename rewriting, graph filters and compatibility with other patches remain unverified.
